explanation: The claim that males require effective contraception for ≥3 months post-dose is not supported by any evidence shown; only female contraception (≥3 weeks) is documented. No male-specific reproductive toxicity or contraception guidance appears in the cited or additional evidence.
suggested_rewrite: Embryo-fetal toxicity: effective contraception required for females of reproductive potential for at least 3 weeks after the last dose; avoid breastfeeding. (Remove unsupported male contraception claim unless separately verified in the label.)
